The first way to shrink the difference is to fit the simulator's parameters (SysID): try multipliers for the mass, friction and actuator stiffness and take the best ones.

Дельта-модель: поправка к команде: Delta model: a correction to the command
Второй способ, как в ASAP: ничего не уга: The second way, as in ASAP: don't guess anything, but learn a correction to the command from the same recorded runs. For each step, we look for the Δa with which the simulator, starting from the recorded state with the command a + Δa, gives the same result as the real Ada with the command a. Then we train a model that predicts Δa from the state and the command. Ours is linear for each joint: it uses the new and the previous commands and the joint's angle and velocity.

Учитель видит положения, повороты и скор: The teacher sees the positions, rotations and velocities of all the links and the difference from the recording at the next frame: 913 numbers. In simulation, it's the upper bound, with 94.77% successful recordings, but the robot doesn't have such data.
H2O учил политику с подкреплением сразу: H2O trained its policy with reinforcement learning directly on what the robot has and fed it eight body points. On the robot, the pelvis velocity required a motion capture system, and the success rate in simulation is 87.52%.
Ученик OmniH2O видит три точки (голову и: The OmniH2O student sees three points (the head and the hands) and the last 25 steps of its own joints instead of the pelvis velocity. It almost catches up with the teacher, 94.10% versus 94.77%, and on the robot it doesn't need a motion capture system.
Без истории DAgger даёт 93,80%, почти ст: Without history, DAgger gives 93.80%, almost the same. In simulation, history barely helps, but on the robot the error without it is larger: 83.26 mm versus 47.94 mm with 25 steps.
Тот же короткий вход, но вместо DAgger о: The same short input, but reinforcement learning instead of DAgger: 90.62%. Without history, the gap to DAgger is small.
С историей из 25 шагов обучение с подкре: With a 25-step history, reinforcement learning barely copes: 47.11% versus 94.10% for DAgger with the same input. The authors write that without DAgger the policy “struggles to learn a coherent policy when provided with a long history,” while DAgger gets the right action in every state.

Универсальный трекер получает во вход ка: A universal tracker gets a frame of the recording as input rather than a phase, as in DeepMimic. What does this change?
Трекер точнее повторяет одну запись: The tracker reproduces a single recording more accurately
Политике не нужно знать, какая это запис: The policy doesn't need to know which recording it is or where in it it is now: the target pose arrives in the command, and one network reproduces any recording
Трекеру больше не нужна физическая симул: The tracker no longer needs a physics simulation
Так H2O учит одну политику на тысячи зап: That's how H2O trains one policy on thousands of recordings, and how OmniH2O and HOVER reproduce poses that come from a VR headset, a camera or a text-to-motion generator. In lesson 6.2, the tracker with a phase was tied to one recording and to its tempo.
Учитель с привилегированной информацией: A teacher with privileged information couldn't reproduce a recording in simulation. What does that say about the recording?
Ничего: учителя просто плохо обучили: Nothing: the teacher was just poorly trained
Её почти наверняка не повторит и политик: A policy that relies on sensors almost certainly won't reproduce it either: the teacher knows more and serves as an upper bound, so such recordings are thrown out
Её нужно только замедлить, и она пройдёт: It only needs to be slowed down, and it will pass
Так работает фильтр H2O: из 10 тысяч пер: That's how H2O's filter works: of 10,000 retargeted recordings, the teacher failed on about 1,500. In Lab 1, slowing down saved the fast bow and the fast kick, but not the back bend: failures have different causes.
Ретаргетинг соблюдает пределы суставов и: Retargeting respects the joint limits and puts the feet on the floor. Why run the recording in physics as well?
Чтобы проверить, нет ли в записи шума: To check whether the recording has noise
Кинематика не проверяет моменты и скорос: Kinematics doesn't check actuator torques and velocities or balance in motion: a recording can look fine in the frames, yet the actuators won't reproduce it
В лаборатории 1 проверка центра масс по: In Lab 1, a center-of-mass check on the recording's frames would have found only the back bend and the forward reach. The fast bow and the fast kick look harmless in the frames, but they fail because of the support leg's velocity limit and the actuator torque limit.
Почему ученика OmniH2O учат повторять уч: Why is the OmniH2O student trained to imitate the teacher (DAgger) rather than with reinforcement learning right away?
У ученика мало информации о теле и длинн: The student has little information about the body and a long history as input; with reinforcement learning, such a policy learned poorly, while DAgger has the right action in every state
С подкреплением нельзя учить политику дл: A policy for a robot can't be trained with reinforcement learning
В таблице OmniH2O ученик с историей из 2: In the OmniH2O table, a student with a 25-step history scored 94.10% with DAgger and 47.11% with reinforcement learning. In lesson 5.5, the same technique let a student without friction data drive almost like the teacher.
Что такое маска команды в HOVER?: What is the command mask in HOVER?
Фильтр, который убирает шум из команды: A filter that removes noise from the command
Биты, которые говорят политике, какие ча: Bits that tell the policy which parts of the command are given; in training they're random, so one policy understands any combination of parts
Веса слагаемых награды для разных режимо: Reward term weights for different modes
Каждый бит маски берут из Bernoulli(0,5): Each bit of the mask is drawn from Bernoulli(0.5) at the start of an episode. That's why the generalist in Lab 2 worked with all four modes of the earlier systems and switched between them in the middle of walking.
В лаборатории 2 специалист в своём режим: In Lab 2, the specialist is more accurate than the generalist in its own mode. Does that mean HOVER is wrong about the generalist?
Да, специалист всегда лучше: Yes, a specialist is always better
Нет: HOVER сравнивал генералиста со спец: No: HOVER compared the generalist with specialists trained with reinforcement learning, while ours both learn from the same teacher; part of HOVER's gain comes from distillation itself
У HOVER генералист, обученный дистилляци: In HOVER, the generalist trained by distillation beats both the specialists and a policy with the same masks trained with reinforcement learning from scratch, so part of its gain comes from distillation itself. In our lab, the specialist is more accurate in its own mode, but in another mode its error is several times larger, while the generalist alone covers all modes.
После дообучения в симуляторе с дельта-м: After fine-tuning in the simulator with the delta model, the policy is put on the robot without the correction. Why does this work?
Поправка слишком медленная для робота, и: The correction is too slow for the robot, so it's turned off for speed
Поправка нужна, чтобы симулятор вёл себя: The correction is there to make the simulator behave like the robot; the robot itself behaves this way anyway, and the policy has already learned to handle it
Не работает: на роботе поправку тоже при: It doesn't: the correction has to be turned on on the robot too
В лаборатории 3 поправка нашла, что кома: In Lab 3, the correction found that the command takes effect one step late. A policy fine-tuned in such a simulator learned to send commands ahead of time and erred less on the real Ada than after the same fine-tuning in the plain simulator.
Что даёт BeyondMimic направление диффузи: What does guiding the diffusion with the gradient of a cost give BeyondMimic?
Ускоряет обучение трекера с подкрепление: It speeds up the tracker's reinforcement learning
Новую задачу, например команду с джойсти: A new task, such as a joystick command, a point on the floor or an obstacle, can be set at inference without new training: the gradient of the cost adjusts the denoising steps
Убирает задержку между командой и привод: It removes the delay between the command and the actuators
Диффузионная модель BeyondMimic учится н: BeyondMimic's diffusion model learns from tracker runs with no task labels. The task cost is differentiable, and at every denoising step its gradient shifts the plan toward completing the task. This way, one model walks by joystick, goes to a point and walks around an obstacle.
